Name: Whisper of Bonds
Description:
Killing Frozen Enemies creates an Orb of Power that grants 2.5% Super Energy.
Incurs a 10 second cooldown after creating an Orb of Power.

Name: Whisper of Chains
Description:
Kills while Frost Armor is active progress a counter that spawns a Small Stasis Shard upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = ?%

Name: Whisper of Chill
Description:
Stasis Weapon Kills progress a counter that spawns a Small Stasis Shard upon reaching 100%.
Rank-And-File = 34% | Elite = 67% | Miniboss+ = 100% | Guardians = 67%
Incurs a 5? second cooldown after creating a Stasis Shard, before additional kills progress the counter.

Name: Whisper of Conduction
Description: Stasis Shards within 15 metres are pulled towards the user after a 1 second delay.

Name: Whisper of Durance
Description:
Slow Debuff Duration and certain abilities last longer.
All affected Slow sources and abilities will have their value with Durance shown in smaller text next to the regular duration or stack amount.
Eg: 25 seconds -> 25+5

Name: Whisper of Fissures
Description:
Shattering enemies or destroying Crystals deals an additional damage instance, dealing up to 25 [9] damage in a 10 [8] metre radius. 
Falloff decreases damage dealt down to a minimum of 17 [4] damage at the maximum falloff distance.

Name: Whisper of Fractures
Description: Grants x1 Frost Armor upon shattering an enemy with Melee Damage.

Name: Whisper of Hedrons
Description: Freezing an enemy grants +? Handling, and +30 Health for 11 seconds.

Name: Whisper of Hunger
Description:
Stasis Shards grant increased Melee Energy.
Small Shards grant 17.5% Melee Energy, from 10%
Large Shards grant 75% Melee Energy, from 50%.

Name: Whisper of Impetus
Description:
Upon dealing Powered Melee Damage:
Refills all weapons and grants +40 Handling for 5 seconds.
Buff duration serves as cooldown.

Name: Whisper of Refraction
Description:
Kills against enemies affected by Stasis effects grants Class Ability Energy based on Enemy Rank.
9% = Tier 1 Combatant
13% = Tier 2 Combatant
15% = Guardian
20% = Tier 3 Combatant
30% = Tier 4 Combatant
40% = Miniboss
50% = Boss

Name: Whisper of Rending
Description:
Primary Ammo Weapons deal 100% increased damage against Stasis Crystals and 50% increased damage against Frozen Enemies.
Includes Fighting Lion, Revision Zero, Vex Mythoclast, and their respective alternate fire modes.

Name: Whisper of Reversal
Description:
While Frost Armor is active:
Dealing or receiving Physical Melee Damage applies x10? Slow for ?+? [?+?] seconds.
Also applies to Glaive Melee.

Name: Whisper of Rime
Description: Enhances Frost Armor, increasing the maximum stack amount to x8, and the duration to 13 seconds.

Name: Whisper of Shards
Description:
Upon destroying a Stasis Crystal: 
Grants 500% [150%] Additional Base Grenade Regeneration Rate for 6 seconds, up to a maximum of 11 seconds.

Name: Whisper of Torment
Description:
Upon receiving damage:
Grants 7% Grenade Ability Energy.
Increased to 12% Grenade Ability Energy while Frost Armor is active.
Incurs a 1 second cooldown between Grenade Energy gains.
